series: Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, Reason #25 (autopilot)
hook: You practise every day. You stopped getting better in month one.

gate.goal_link: any skill goal (instrument, language, sport): daily practice that stopped producing progress
gate.mechanism: once a skill feels easy it becomes automatic (autonomous stage, Fitts & Posner); comfortable repetition maintains it, only practice just past current level grows it. No study number cited.
gate.universal: typing every day for years without getting faster

frame.obstacle: practice becomes autopilot once it's easy
frame.cost: months 2-6 at the same five songs (illustration)
frame.fix: every session add one thing just out of reach: song +5 bpm until it breaks, fix the bar that breaks; a page slightly too hard
